title: Bridge Street in Heywood closed as emergency services attend incident
excerpt: Roch Valley Radio reports a closure on Bridge Street, with photographs showing a police cordon and a fire engine at the scene.
body:
Bridge Street in Heywood has been closed by emergency services, according to a report shared by Roch Valley Radio on Saturday evening, 24 October.

Photographs accompanying the broadcaster's Facebook post show police tape across the road, a marked police car blocking access and a fire engine at the scene.

The post does not explain the nature of the incident. It contains no confirmed information about injuries, the reason for the cordon or when the road will reopen.

The presence of firefighters does not, by itself, confirm that a fire has occurred.

Drivers approaching Bridge Street should allow extra time and follow any directions given by emergency services. The photographs show a closure, but the precise extent of the restrictions has not been established.

This report is based on Roch Valley Radio's post and the accompanying photographs, supplied to Rochdale Daily by a reader. Further verified information will be added to this article as it becomes available.
